svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 115 mm leaves with a 75 mm cavity: 305 mm wall. Outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay both leaves on the damp-proof strip together, a few courses

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at a time. Wall ties across the cavity every 900 mm along and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every 450 mm up, staggered; keep the cavity clear of mortar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Door opening (door end, centred): 840 wide, from 100 to 1,920 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above ground. Bricks under it (to 100 mm) are the door sill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pad opening (pad end, centred): 640 wide x 540 high, from 980

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lintels at 1,920 mm (door) and 1,520 mm (pad): see ZBX-DWG-104.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fill the cavity as the walls rise (ZBX-BLD-001 step 3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Capping course: the top 75 mm (2,025 to 2,100) bridges both leaves

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the cavity in one course, in mortar, closing the fill in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plumb, level top within 10 mm, openings square.
